headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; discussed grant season outreach, the 2027 budget, and Methuen Day table plans.
summary: The group reviewed 2026 grant reports and grant season flyers. It discussed the 2027 budget of $40,600 and a table schedule for Methuen Day on October 3. It approved the minutes of the August 10, 2026 meeting.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 10, 2026 meeting, with 5 yes votes and one member absent.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to accept the minutes: Olivia. Second: Taana. Vote: 5 yes, one absent. Motion passed.

plain_text:
Methuen Cultural Council 2026   
   
Ellen Baranowski - Chair  
Olivia Chung - Member 
Taana Latu -Member   
Luis Sanchez - Member  
Carey Smith- Member   
Catherine Zembruski – Member  
  
 
  
Meeting Minutes 
Monday, September 14, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
     Location:  Nevins Memorial Library,  Study Room 
1 Call to Order/Roll Call/Vote to Accept Agenda/Public Participation   
Meeting commenced at 6:25 PM.  In attendance: Ellen Baranowski, Olivia Chung, Taana Latu, 
Carey Smith, Catherine Zembruski.  Absent: Luis Sanchez.  Motion to accept the agenda: Taana.  
Second: Catherine. Vote: 5 yes, one absent.  Motion passed.  No public participation.   
 
2 Reading and Approval of Minutes- August 10, 2026 meeting    
Motion to accept the minutes: Olivia.  Second: Taana.  Vote:  5 yes, one absent.  Motion passed.      
                         
3 Financial Report- Update    
Ellen presented the 2026 budget, updated  09/05/2026. 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
4 Unfinished Council Business   Review of 2026 Grants   
Although all 26 grantees have been paid and 23 of them have taken place, a few grantees have 
not submitted their final reports; grants 8, 9, 10, 18, 19, 22, 23.  I shared that grant 24 has not 
taken place and I have not been able to reach the grantee, but Catherine knew that she was 
planning to perform at the Senior Center on Tuesday, September 15. 
                                                                                                                     
5 New Council Business 
Grant Season (September 1-October 15) Flyers 
Flyers were distributed to each member, as well as City Hall, the Senior Center, and the Nevins 
Memorial Library.  Also, the flyer was printed in the October issue of Methuen Life (quarter-
page, color advertisement = $300.)  Of course our own MCC Social Media sites ran the ad.  
Thank you to our Outreach Committee for creating it. 
 
2027 “Goals and Priorities” and Budget 
The one addition to the goals and priorities that the group made (a venue must be listed), was 
inadvertently left off the new list.  Ellen submitted the Gs&Ps without that line.   
The 2027 budget was distributed:  $40,600 (plus left over monies from 2026… (to be determined 
after Ellen’s meeting with the city accountant in late September.)
Methuen Day October 3rd  11:00 AM-3:00 PM 
  table schedule 
  10:30-12:00 Taana and Ellen 
  12:00-1:30 Catherine and Luis 
  1:30-3:00 Carey and Ellen 
Taana will bring a tent if she has one that fits the 10x10 requirement.  Table and 2 chairs will be 
provided by Parks and Recreation Department. 
  
 Look at initial grants on-line, as a review on accessing them 
 The team looked at the first grant submission, as a reminder about how to  get on line to view 
the grants electronically. 
 
6 Engagement and Outreach Subcommittee Report  
Public Survey 
The committee submitted a draft of the public survey that will be accessible on Methuen Day.  A 
final copy will be submitted to Ellen, after edits.   Ellen will make 100 copies. 
 
T-Shirts 
The committee will work on t-shirts for the group, with a couple of extras for future members.  
They brought a great idea as an outline.  The money will be taken from the 2026 Administrative 
Funds. 
 
7 Announcements/Miscellaneous  
Prepare for discussion of grants during the October meeting.  Bring your notes. 
After the October 19th meeting, we will decide if one more meeting in November will be enough 
to get us to the finish line on the 2027 grant decisions (which are due January 18, 2027) 
   
8 Adjourn 
Motion to adjourn: Catherine. Second: Taana.  Vote: 5 yes, one absent.  Meeting adjourned at 
7:02 PM 
                                                                         
 
 
Next Regular Meeting:  October 19, 2026; 6:30 PM                         
 
Anyone needing an access accommodation to participate in City of Methuen programs or services, please contact Sandy Almonte, ADA/DEI 
Coordinator at 978-382-2123 or salmonte@ci.methuen.ma.us at least two weeks in advance, or two business days before a board or 
commission meeting.  This notice is available in alternate formats upon request.
